part.text:
Fixed. The root cause: `@UtilityClass` makes inner classes static and detaches their enclosing type, but the cached `erasure_field` on the `ClassSymbol` still reflects the old (non-static, generic) type. When javac later erases that symbol during inference (`Types.asSuper`), it hits the stale/null erasure and crashes with an NPE.

Changes:
- `src/core/lombok/javac/JavacResolution.java:632` — when handling inner classes of a `@UtilityClass`, also reset `innerClassSymbol.erasure_field = null` so javac recomputes the erasure after the class was made static (guarded so a non-`ClassType` symbol still gets its erasure reset).
- `src/stubs/com/sun/tools/javac/code/Symbol.java` — added the `erasure_field` field to the compile-time stub (present in javac since JDK 6).
